miss_category_definitions.surface: Shortened, abbreviated, generic or misspelled endpoint names, without an accepted exact alias. Descriptive candidates are not credited as equivalent.
miss_category_definitions.relation: Related finding expressed with a different relation or direction, sometimes also a different endpoint. No relation remapping.
miss_category_definitions.scope: Candidate carries a different population, isolate, accession or treatment qualifier. Includes wrong-population candidates, which must not be equated.
miss_category_definitions.absent: No comparable efficacy/resistance/combination assertion. Ingredient-only and mode-of-action statements do not substitute.
